utility.notes: The City of Santa Barbara is confirmed to be within SCE's distribution service territory, per SCE's own published service-area description — independently checked rather than assumed from county location, since parts of Santa Barbara County (e.g., Santa Maria, Lompoc) are not SCE territory.

generation_supplier.notes: Central Coast Community Energy (3CE)'s own official site names Santa Barbara only as a county, not as a specific member city, and the City of Santa Barbara itself does not appear in 3CE's list of named member communities. Per the mission's rule against inferring CCA participation from county membership, generation_supplier is left null rather than assumed.
